evidence_and_limit: Public source descriptions identify UK Biobank for insomnia, iPSYCH/deCODE/10 European PGC cohorts for ADHD discovery, and Finnish biobank/register data for the FinnGen R13 ADHD outcome; the ten PGC cohorts were not enumerated in the reviewed main-text source and participant-level overlap is unverified. FinnGen replication remains directional only. See qc/cohort_overlap_insomnia_adhd_replication_20260925.md.
Both discovery sources include UK Biobank; individual-level overlap and covariance are unverified.

The checked Trubetskoy et al. 2022 PGC3 case-control sample descriptions do not name UK Biobank as a contributing cohort; exact participant/control overlap remains unverified, so this pair is not classified as independent. See qc/cohort_overlap_scz_followup_20260925.md and its provenance sidecar.

The locked long-sleep GWAS is Dashti et al. 2019 UK Biobank (PMID 30846698); the selected bipolar GWAS is Mullins et al. 2021, whose methods explicitly include UK Biobank among five external cohort GWASs (PMID 34002096). UK Biobank cohort overlap is documented; exact participant-level overlap and its induced covariance are unverified. Sources: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6405943/ ; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8192451/.
Sleep GWAS uses UK Biobank; PD GWAS includes UK Biobank proxy cases; individual overlap is unverified.
